Chapter 700: Chapter 8 Auroras from Beyond the Cosmos (Please Subscribe)_2

“`

Whoosh.

In the center of Battlefield A076, deep within an Eternal Spatial Rift thousands of miles long, a grey fog slowly dissipated.

Deep within the Eternal Spatial Rift, the grey fog was omnipresent.

This was the Chaos Void, the birthplace of countless universes, the Chaos Void.

And at a far distance outside this Eternal Spatial Rift, an aurora-like radiance, scintillating with brilliant colors, shot through with incredible speed.

...

Where the ‘aurora’ passed, all the grey fog was evaporated completely.

Hum.

Just a few breaths had passed.

The dazzling aurora had penetrated deep into the Eternal Spatial Rift.

…

Battlefield A076.

Many strong entities were engaged in battle.

Even powerhouses of Tier 10 Grade A and Tier 11 occasionally entered the fray, influencing the tilt of the scales in localized wars.

At that moment.

Above the battlefield, within the Eternal Spatial Rift, a dazzling aurora burst forth.

Boom boom boom.

The aurora tore through everything; even the incredibly stable space of the large battlefield was as fragile as thin paper, and even the battlefield itself was exceedingly weak.

“Aaargh?”

“What is this?”

On the battlefield, many Eleventh-Rank Lives hadn’t even reacted before they were reduced to dust by the aurora.

In the blink of an eye, Battlefield A076, spanning hundreds to thousands of light-years in diameter, collapsed rapidly, with countless lives, including Eleventh Rank Powerhouses, all perishing.

Moreover, an invisible wave, following each dead life form, spread towards all directions of the universe.

“This?”

“This aurora?”

Around the battlefield, towering figures appeared, their faces grave as they observed the shattered Large Alien Battlefield and that still mighty, undiminished, brilliant-colored aurora.

“Stop it.”

More than ten towering figures took action swiftly, power transcending time and space spreading unceasingly, and ultimately, they contained the aurora.

“This aurora carries the power of a Causal Curse Killing; every life that dies under the aurora has to bear the corresponding Causal Curse Killing.”

“Lives below the Tenth Rank should not be able to withstand it.”

“Which ancient relic’s method is this again?”

The more than ten towering figures were all Supreme Beings. They exchanged a few words and started to study the aurora.

Over the long years, various variables often poured into the Eternal Spatial Rift, like the body of a Supreme Being over a hundred years ago, as well as the brilliant aurora that just appeared.

Both entities clearly reached the Twelfth Rank Level, especially that aurora. After traversing an endless distance, the remaining might was still tremendously terrifying.

…

What happened in Alien Race Battlefield Code A076 quickly spread to all the Myriad Clans of the Cosmic Starry Sky.

“What?”

“A Large Alien Battlefield has disappeared?”

Lin Yuan blinked, looking at Nalan, the Tower Sub-Master.

The size of each Large Alien Battlefield was hundreds of light-years in diameter, and even within the vast Cosmic Starry Skies, they were considered colossal.

How could it just vanish into thin air?

“It is said that it was shattered by an aurora from beyond the universe,” Nalan, the Tower Sub-Master, said with an unusually shocked tone.

Normally, Large Alien Battlefields, personally refined by Supreme Beings, are difficult to destroy.

Even in battles between Supreme Being, only parts of it would be shattered at most, as they tend to avoid damaging the battlefield as much as possible when clashing.

“An aurora from beyond the universe?” Lin Yuan raised an eyebrow.

“Exactly,” said Nalan, the Tower Sub-Master, “An aurora from beyond the universe shattered the entire Large Alien Battlefield. If not for the Supreme Beings’ intervention, that aurora’s might could have caused widespread devastation.”

This incident was no secret; now the entire Myriad Clans of the Cosmic Starry Sky were abuzz with it.

“Terrifying.”

Lin Yuan fell silent for a while.

He had long known that the dangers on the Large Alien Battlefields were not limited to the Different Species.

Outside the Eternal Spatial Rift, the many perils of the Chaos Void also threatened all the strong entities on the battlefield.

“What has become of that aurora now?” Lin Yuan couldn’t help asking.

“Not sure,” replied Nalan, the Tower Sub-Master, shaking her head, “It’s likely fallen into the hands of a Supreme Being.”

“That aurora carries the power of Causal Curse Killing. All lives below Ninth Rank and Eighth Rank that died under the aurora, along with their Avatars, perished completely. Our Human Civilization has lost over a million Ninth Rank and Eighth Rank lives because of this,” Nalan added.

“Causal Curse Killing power…” Lin Yuan’s expression grew solemn.

Such a widespread curse killing power against Ninth and Eighth Rank lives, even to a Supreme Being, would be a burden.

“So, the next date for Human Civilization’s resurrection should be moved up,” said Nalan, the Tower Sub-Master.

Based on past patterns, the next time Supreme Beings would act to resurrect lives should be in two thousand years.

But with the collapse of a Large Alien Battlefield, the number of evolved Human Civilization lives lost has suddenly surged several levels, effectively filling up the resurrection list for the next two thousand years.

Under such circumstances, Supreme Beings usually take action to resurrect earlier than planned.

“The resurrection date will be moved up?”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly. He wasn’t entirely clueless about this.

When Supreme Beings resurrect dead lives, it’s not based on intervals of time.

It’s based on the number of dead lives, that is, the number of Evolvers on the resurrection list.

Once the number of Evolvers on the resurrection list reaches the threshold, Supreme Beings will act to resurrect en masse.

…

In the personal Virtual World of Xia Qin Supreme Being.

“Supreme Being.”

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared, bowing slightly to Xia Qin Supreme Being seated on the throne.

“How is it?”

“How’s your comprehension of the Fusion Rules within the Heritage Star going?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being asked with a smile on his face.
